chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), describing the companions of the Messenger of Allah, that was on the day of Siffin, when he ordered the people to peace.

key_terms.أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: companions of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the companions of the Prophet on the day of Siffin?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal Battle of Siffin, this narration captures Imam Ali’s nuanced assessment of the Prophet’s companions as he prepared for the arbitration (Hukm) with Muawiyah. It highlights the tension between his military readiness and his strategic acceptance of peace to preserve the unity of the early Muslim community, a key event in Shia historiography. The description serves to contextualize the companions' varying degrees of loyalty and their subsequent political shifts.
